description: This PHP source file defines a client class for interacting with the Amazon Interactive Video Service RealTime API. It declares methods for various operations such as creating, deleting, and fetching configurations and resources related to the service, using PHPDoc annotations. The class extends the AWS SDK's generic AwsClient class.
